caveats: A session may span calendar days; this is a lifetime point-in-time count, not session-days.
definition: Provider sessions observed across Claude Code and Codex CLI on WSL and Windows.
derivation: COUNT of canonical session rows after event-level and cross-root deduplication by vendor plus provider session id.

caveats: Token classes are provider-specific and should not be treated as equal units of work.
definition: All observed billable token classes across both providers and host operating systems.
derivation: SUM Anthropic(input + cache_write_5m + cache_write_1h + cache_read + output) + SUM OpenAI(input + output); cached_input is already inside input and reasoning_output is already inside output.

caveats: This is not either provider subscription invoice; unpriced tokens are excluded.
definition: API-list-price equivalent for usage whose exact observed model has a configured price.
derivation: SUM per session of exact-model token-class quantity / 1,000,000 x the matching price; OpenAI non-cached input is input - cached_input and reasoning is not added again.

caveats: Best-effort ranges remain separate and never enter exact API-equivalent cost.
definition: Observed tokens excluded from exact dollars because no exact model-price row matched.
derivation: SUM sessions.unpriced_tokens; no prefix, declared-model, or vendor-average fallback is used.

caveats: Composition describes measured volume, not quality or productivity.
definition: Lifetime observed token composition between Anthropic and OpenAI.
derivation: GROUP lifetime session token totals by vendor, then divide each vendor total by the two-vendor sum.

caveats: host_os is process location, not the working directory's filesystem.
definition: Lifetime observed token composition by the operating system hosting the provider process.
derivation: GROUP lifetime session token totals by host_os (wsl or windows), then divide each total by the host sum.

caveats: UTC date boundaries are used; cached and reasoning subsets are not double-counted. The prior delta is unavailable for all-time or when a complete preceding equal-length window falls before that metric's observed source coverage.
definition: Observed provider tokens whose UTC daily bucket falls inside the selected inclusive window.
derivation: SUM days.tokens WHERE date >= window.from AND date <= window.to; tile delta = current total - the immediately preceding equal-length UTC window total.

caveats: Unpriced usage is excluded and subscription fees are not included. The prior delta is unavailable for all-time or when a complete preceding equal-length window falls before that metric's observed source coverage.
definition: Exact API-equivalent dollars in the selected inclusive UTC window.
derivation: SUM days.api_equivalent_cost_usd WHERE date >= window.from AND date <= window.to; tile delta = current total - the immediately preceding equal-length UTC window total.

caveats: One provider session active on two UTC dates contributes two session-days. The prior delta is unavailable for all-time or when a complete preceding equal-length window falls before that metric's observed source coverage.
definition: Daily session presences in the selected inclusive UTC window.
derivation: SUM days.sessions WHERE date >= window.from AND date <= window.to; tile delta = current total - the immediately preceding equal-length UTC window total.

caveats: Zero-activity days remain in the window denominator but not this numerator. The prior delta is unavailable for all-time or when a complete preceding equal-length window falls before that metric's observed source coverage.
definition: Calendar days in the selected window with at least one observed token or session-day.
derivation: COUNT DISTINCT date after daily aggregation WHERE tokens > 0 OR session_days > 0; tile delta subtracts the immediately preceding equal-length UTC window count.

caveats: Bucket labels show their inclusive bounds; plotted downsampling preserves the exact window total.
definition: Machine-wide token volume over the selected UTC window.
derivation: SUM days.tokens by date; adjacent UTC dates are summed into consecutive buckets only when the series exceeds 48 points.

caveats: Unpriced tokens remain outside this line and are reported separately.
definition: Machine-wide exact API-equivalent dollars over the selected UTC window.
derivation: SUM days.api_equivalent_cost_usd by date using the same consecutive at-most-48 buckets as the token trend.

caveats: Anonymous project codes do not expose the local registry mapping. The prior delta is unavailable for all-time or when a complete preceding equal-length window falls before that metric's observed source coverage.
definition: Public project identities or explicit bulk buckets active in the selected UTC window.
derivation: COUNT DISTINCT days.project_id WHERE date is inside the inclusive window and tokens > 0 OR sessions > 0; tile delta subtracts the immediately preceding equal-length UTC window count.

caveats: Ad-hoc is a measured bulk bucket, not a single project. The prior delta is unavailable for all-time or when a complete preceding equal-length window falls before that metric's observed source coverage.
definition: Tokens assigned to the explicit ad-hoc bulk bucket in the selected window.
derivation: SUM days.tokens WHERE project_id = 'ad-hoc' AND date is inside the inclusive window; tile delta subtracts the immediately preceding equal-length UTC window total.

caveats: Remote is a measured bulk bucket and must not be reverse-engineered. The prior delta is unavailable for all-time or when a complete preceding equal-length window falls before that metric's observed source coverage.
definition: Tokens assigned to the explicit remote bulk bucket in the selected window.
derivation: SUM days.tokens WHERE project_id = 'remote' AND date is inside the inclusive window; tile delta subtracts the immediately preceding equal-length UTC window total.

caveats: This is point-in-time and outside the selected date window; codes and mappings are not shown on the compact page.
definition: Current anonymous working-directory clusters not covered by a registry entry or explicit bulk bucket.
derivation: COUNT of the current observatory unregistered-candidate code set after canonicalization.

caveats: The other slice states how many identities it combines; exhaustive rows remain in projects.jsonl.
definition: Selected-window token composition for the six highest-volume public identities plus one exact tail rollup.
derivation: SUM days.tokens by project_id inside the window; sort descending with project_id tie-break; show first 6 and other = total - SUM(top 6).

caveats: Point-in-time lifetime composition because exact per-day model allocation is not stored; exhaustive session rows remain in sessions.jsonl.
definition: Lifetime token composition for the six highest-volume observed session-model buckets plus one exact tail rollup.
derivation: Assign each canonical session to its one observed model, or to mixed/unknown when it has multiple/no observed models; SUM provider-correct session tokens by bucket; show first 6 and other = total - SUM(top 6).

caveats: An accepted spec is counted once even if multiple retained round records carry terminal evidence. The prior delta is unavailable for all-time or when a complete preceding equal-length window falls before that metric's observed source coverage.
definition: Distinct governed-loop specs with an accepted round ending inside the selected UTC window.
derivation: COUNT DISTINCT rounds.spec_id WHERE accepted = true AND ended_at date is inside the inclusive window; tile delta subtracts the immediately preceding equal-length UTC window count.

caveats: This is an outcome ratio, not judge-round acceptance rate. The prior delta is unavailable for all-time or when a complete preceding equal-length window falls before that metric's observed source coverage.
definition: Share of governed-loop specs represented in the window that reached acceptance in that window.
derivation: accepted_features / COUNT DISTINCT rounds.spec_id in the window; null when no specs are represented; tile delta is current ratio - the immediately preceding equal-length UTC window ratio, in percentage points.

caveats: The numerator includes non-terminal attempts for specs represented in the window; unpriced usage and subscriptions are excluded. The prior delta is unavailable for all-time or when a complete preceding equal-length window falls before that metric's observed source coverage.
definition: Mean selected-window governed-loop exact cost per accepted feature cycle.
derivation: SUM rounds.api_equivalent_cost_usd for all window rounds / accepted_features; null when accepted_features = 0; tile delta subtracts the immediately preceding equal-length UTC window mean.

caveats: Wall clock includes queue idle; clamped boundary values remain in the distribution and the all-time anomaly count stays in the full envelope because source anomalies are not day-attributed. The prior delta is unavailable for all-time or when a complete preceding equal-length window falls before that metric's observed source coverage.
definition: Median complete governed-loop judge-round wall time in the selected window.
derivation: Median of duration_minutes for rounds ending inside the window; raw verdict timestamp - dispatch timestamp is clamped to [0, 2,880] minutes and every clamp increments the anomaly count; tile delta subtracts the immediately preceding equal-length UTC window median.

caveats: A round belongs to exactly one bucket using its ended_at timestamp.
definition: Accepted and non-accepted governed-loop rounds by UTC completion date.
derivation: COUNT rounds by ended_at UTC date and accepted boolean, then sum adjacent dates into at most 48 consecutive buckets.

caveats: This ranks API-equivalent exact cost only; unpriced tokens remain separate.
definition: Six highest exact-cost governed-loop specs in the selected window plus an exact tail rollup.
derivation: SUM round exact cost by spec_id inside the window; sort descending with spec_id tie-break; other = total - SUM(top 6).

caveats: Client clock error can affect this display; the collector's separate clock guard protects writes.
definition: Elapsed time since the bounded page envelope was generated.
derivation: MAX(0, browser_now - generated_at) in minutes, recomputed in the browser every minute.

caveats: Point-in-time; individual check rows are available in the collapsed diagnostics and full envelope.
definition: Latest overall result of the observatory self-check battery.
derivation: fail if any doctor check fails; else warn if any warns; else ok.

caveats: Only observed log coverage is assessed; powered-off periods before logging began cannot be reconstructed.
definition: Estimated half-hour collection intervals absent from the observed wrapper log.
derivation: For each closed start gap over 45 minutes add MAX(1, FLOOR(gap_minutes / 30) - 1); for an open gap over 45 minutes add MAX(1, FLOOR(age_minutes / 30)).

caveats: This is an upper-bound growth projection, not a fitted forecast.
definition: Conservative years of free space at the shorter measured drive-level growth bound.
derivation: MIN by governed drive of free_bytes / projected_annual_growth_bytes, using the documented 30-day mtime-cohort upper-bound method.

caveats: A partial root with only a live trailing record can remain usable and therefore does not necessarily make the overall doctor warn.
definition: Current completeness state of the four provider roots spanning two vendors and two host OSes.
derivation: COUNT current source_roots as complete when status = ok and error_files = 0; all partial, absent, timeout, or error states enter the explicitly labeled other slice.

caveats: Measurement history begins when the capability was installed and is never backfilled.
definition: Share of collection-time source probes reported healthy in the selected measurement window.
derivation: SUM source status_counts.ok / SUM all source status counts across measurement days inside the window.

caveats: Complete retained round records only. The prior delta is unavailable for all-time or when a complete preceding equal-length window falls before that metric's observed source coverage.
definition: Governed-loop rounds ending inside the selected inclusive UTC window.
derivation: COUNT rounds WHERE ended_at date is inside the window; tile delta subtracts the immediately preceding equal-length UTC window count.

caveats: This is a round count and differs from distinct accepted feature cycles. The prior delta is unavailable for all-time or when a complete preceding equal-length window falls before that metric's observed source coverage.
definition: Governed-loop rounds with an acceptance verdict inside the selected window.
derivation: COUNT rounds WHERE accepted = true AND ended_at date is inside the window; tile delta subtracts the immediately preceding equal-length UTC window count.

caveats: Structured arrays are authoritative; legacy prose parsing is used only for old records. The prior delta is unavailable for all-time or when a complete preceding equal-length window falls before that metric's observed source coverage.
definition: Structured blocking findings reported by selected-window judge rounds.
derivation: SUM rounds.findings WHERE ended_at date is inside the window; tile delta subtracts the immediately preceding equal-length UTC window total.

caveats: Unpriced usage and subscription amortization are excluded. The prior delta is unavailable for all-time or when a complete preceding equal-length window falls before that metric's observed source coverage.
definition: Exact API-equivalent cost attributed to governed-loop rounds in the selected window.
derivation: SUM rounds.api_equivalent_cost_usd WHERE ended_at date is inside the window; tile delta subtracts the immediately preceding equal-length UTC window total.

caveats: Wall time includes queue idle; source anomalies are not day-attributed, so the all-time clamp count appears beside the median headline.
definition: Median governed-loop round duration over consecutive selected-window UTC buckets.
derivation: For each at-most-48 consecutive bucket, median(duration_minutes) over complete rounds after raw deltas are clamped to [0, 2,880] minutes with clamps counted as anomalies.

caveats: This compact ledger is a preview; complete immutable rows remain at the documented machine URLs.
definition: Six most recently completed governed-loop specs represented in the selected window.
derivation: GROUP rounds by spec_id; order by MAX(ended_at) descending then spec_id; show first 6 with exact grouped rounds, tokens, cost, findings, and outcome.

caveats: Machine-only because this is an account-wide point-in-time subscription limit, not billing; raw command output and account identifiers are never stored.
definition: Latest normalized percentage-only Claude /usage snapshot.
derivation: Run the built-in /usage command in zero-turn print mode, require zero inference tokens/cost, then read only five-hour and seven-day utilization from Claude's structured local cache; use its fetched timestamp, retain last-good on failure, and never infer a missing value.

caveats: Machine-only detail; this is a point-in-time rollout observation, not a billing balance.
definition: Latest observed OpenAI rate-limit remaining percentage.
derivation: Use the newest honest rate-limit observation and retain its observed_at and source; never fill null with a guess.

caveats: Machine-only local configuration; never add this value to API-equivalent dollars.
definition: Configured monthly provider subscriptions amortized over accepted feature cycles.
derivation: SUM configured vendor monthly USD / accepted_features; current local configuration totals 400 USD/month.

caveats: Machine-only estimate; older events without exact models cannot be priced exactly.
definition: Separate low, midpoint, and high dollar estimates for observed unpriced tokens.
derivation: Apply the configured verified rate envelope only to eligible unpriced token classes; report low/midpoint/high separately and never add them to exact cost.

caveats: Machine-only all-time count because source anomalies are not attributed to a publishable day.
definition: Count of matched judge-round wall-time deltas outside the accepted zero-to-48-hour range.
derivation: For each matched dispatch/verdict pair, increment once when raw seconds < 0 or > 172,800; clamp that delta to the nearest boundary before adding it to the duration distribution.

caveats: Machine-only exhaustive detail; the page shows top six plus other.
definition: Every public project identity and bulk bucket in the machine tier.
derivation: One projects.jsonl record per public project_id with lifetime aggregates.

caveats: Machine-only exhaustive detail; the page shows a capped recent-spec preview.
definition: Every retained governed-loop round in numeric order.
derivation: One rounds.jsonl record per stable round_id; sort round_number numerically within spec_id.

caveats: Machine-only exhaustive detail; page trends are exact but capped to 48 consecutive buckets.
definition: Every UTC project/vendor/host daily rollup in the machine tier.
derivation: One days.jsonl record per date, project_id, vendor, and host_os tuple.
